added_findings.title: Whole-file ports must remap drawing-folder import paths (40->42, 42->43)
added_findings.detail:
Three import lines in this slice's TV files use TV's top-level drawing folder numbers, which differ in VV:
- TV Panel__ViewportSettings__.js:206 imports '../../40__System__DrawingViewCore/Na__DrawView__ProjectData__.js'. VV's 40 is the legacy 40__System__2dElevationsView.
- :207 imports '../../42__System__FloorPlanViews/Na__FloorPlan__ProjectJson__Data__.js'. VV's 42 is DrawingViewCore.
- TV Panel__ScrapbookParametric__.js:199 imports '../../40__System__DrawingViewCore/...'.

A byte-for-byte copy therefore imports files that do not exist in VV, and the whole editor fails to link. The survey's 'header seam' for whole-file ports does not mention this. VV's own copies already use 42 (VV Panel__ViewportSettings__.js imports '../../42__System__DrawingViewCore'). No other in-scope TV file imports a renumbered top-level folder.
added_findings.recommendation: Every whole-file port applies the folder map from section 4.1 of the realign plan to '../../NN__' specifiers (40->42, 42->43, 43->44, 44->45, 45->46, 46->47), and records it in the PORT NOTE as a standing seam. Run Na__Verify__ModuleGraph__ and Na__Verify__Exports__ 51__System__LayoutEditor after each port; both PASS on VV today, 01-Oct-2026. Na__FpData__GetStoreyLevel must also exist in VV's 43__System__FloorPlanViews/Na__FloorPlan__ProjectJson__Data__.js first; today the name is missing.
added_findings.evidence: TV Panel__ViewportSettings__.js:206-207; TV Panel__ScrapbookParametric__.js:199; VV 02__Src__AppModules listing (40__System__2dElevationsView, 42__System__DrawingViewCore, 43__System__FloorPlanViews); verify_s06a/vdeps.py resolution with the folder map; grep of TV LE/40 and LE/55-58 for '../../4N__' finds only these three lines
added_findings.vv_adaptation: A standing seam: TV folder numbers in '../../NN__' imports are rewritten to VV's, per section 4.1 of the realign plan.
